distribution_model.detail: B2B: supplies games, systems, hardware and services to licensed gaming, betting and lottery operators; not sold to consumers directly.

market_position.detail: B2B supplier to gaming operators; consumer price positioning does not apply.

notes: B2B supplier, so consumer-facing facets are inferred at the end-player level; market position left not applicable.

product_category.detail: Slots, virtual sports, casino games and gaming machines used by players via operators.

purchase_frequency.detail: Players choose to gamble at their discretion; operators license content continuously.

sub_sector.value: B2B gaming content and technology; virtual sports; retail gaming machines
